“`

The Chikun Star Lord could produce it, but most likely he’d have to “smash the pot and sell the iron.”

And Lin Yuan felt bad for asking the Chikun Star Lord to make such a big sacrifice.

“I still have to rely on myself…” Lin Yuan thought silently in his heart.

The energy that supported the expansion of the inner world, Lin Yuan currently possessed as well, that was the Cosmic Crystal.

However, the Cosmic Crystal was too precious, using it as nourishment for the expansion of the inner world was too extravagant.

...

Lin Yuan planned to use the Cosmic Crystal to purchase another type of energy, similar to the Red Spirit Fluid.

A single Cubic Universe Crystal could buy hundreds of tons of this kind of pure energy, which in expanding the inner world could have the effect of devouring hundreds of Cubic Universe Crystals.

The reason why Cosmic Crystals were expensive was that they contained extremely pure and high-level cosmic energy, but for the expansion of the inner world, any energy would suffice, without much demand for purity.

Therefore, using the Cosmic Crystal to provide for the expansion of the inner world was an act out of necessity, normally no evolver would do such a thing.

Moreover, the expansion of Lin Yuan’s inner world wasn’t in the tens or hundreds of miles but spanned tens of millions of miles.

“The Power of Creation… no, it’s the Cosmic Force…”

Lin Yuan looked towards the heavens of his inner world, where the Taiji force, transformed from the black and white of Yin and Yang, occupied one region, while twelve kinds of higher-ranking Power of Creation each occupied another region.

Finally, more than sixty types of ordinary Power of Creation occupied a third region.

And in the center of all the Powers of Creation, the Primal Force sat enthroned at the center, with a single realm Primal Force actually suppressing more than ten high-ranking Powers of Creation and over sixty ordinary Powers of Creation from getting close.

Among them was even the Taiji force that had reached the Third Realm.

Humm.

Lin Yuan watched one type of Power of Creation after another.

Between the lines, an inexplicable fluctuation converged toward Lin Yuan’s physical body from the cosmic starry sky outside.

Lin Yuan had the feeling that as long as he opened up the barrier between his inner world and the outside, these Powers of Creation would leave imprints in the cosmic starry skies, transform into Cosmic Forces, and thereafter belong only to Lin Yuan.

“Am I now, considered an invincible of the Eighth Layer?”

Lin Yuan looked puzzled.

Theoretically, understanding a single Cosmic Force meant invincibility at the Eighth Layer.

But now, Lin Yuan had comprehended almost a hundred Cosmic Forces, including more than ten high-level Cosmic Forces and even the Primal Force, a power that was unfathomable, transcending even the high-level Cosmic Forces.

In the Spirit Realm, a Supreme Immortal King who mastered a complete Power of Creation, if at least at the First Realm, would be on par with an invincible of the Eighth Layer from the Main World.

And with Lin Yuan’s strength in the Spirit Realm, ordinary invincibles of the Eighth Layer could be killed in droves.

Here it is killing, not just suppression or repelling.

Even now, with Lin Yuan’s strength not fully recovered, with the dozens of Cosmic Forces at his command, killing an Eighth Layer invincible wasn’t difficult.

Even if it’s just mastering one Cosmic Force, with an inner world tens of millions of miles in circumference, Lin Yuan would definitely be one of the stronger among the Eighth Layer invincibles, let alone mastering dozens of Cosmic Forces.

Among them was also the Taiji force, a high-level Cosmic Force that had been cultivated to the Third Realm.

“I can feel that the so-called Cosmic Force, the impact it has on the inner world…” Lin Yuan felt deeply, having discovered in the Spirit Realm early on that the Cosmic Force could make the inner world more stable.

Comparable to the Milky Way Main Star of a galaxy as rare treasures.

This was still just an ordinary Cosmic Force, let alone a higher-ranking one. That strand of mysterious Primal Force directly caused a significant increase in the stability of Lin Yuan’s inner world.

This was a qualitative change.

The more stable the inner world, the more powerful the projected World Force. When two Eighth Layer powerhouses clashed, their World Forces collided, as did their inner worlds.

With the current stability of Lin Yuan’s inner world, a mere touch would cause other Eighth Layer powerhouses’ inner worlds to collapse.

“My current combat power, if fully unleashed, is at least not weaker than a Ninth Rank.” Lin Yuan assessed himself.

An Eighth Layer invincible could survive in front of a Ninth Rank powerhouse, and Lin Yuan believed he could arm-wrestle with a real Ninth Rank powerhouse.

“Right.”

“There’s also the Divine Skill ‘Enhancement’ imprint…”

With a thought from Lin Yuan, an incredibly complicated imprint coalesced.

The Divine Skill ‘Enhancement’, a Divine Skill Lin Yuan awakened on his body in the Spirit Realm, although not a passive Divine Skill like Blood Rebirth.

Still, this Divine Skill could definitely be considered Lin Yuan’s trump card.

Once the Divine Skill ‘Enhancement’ was activated, Lin Yuan would obtain a tenfold increase, which was a terrifying boost to his combat power.

The only drawback was that it could only last for ten breaths, and after activation, he would fall into a brief period of weakness.

But even so, Lin Yuan placed exceptional importance on this Divine Skill, spending nearly thirty years to fully understand it, forming a Divine Ability Imprint with his Main World physical body as the template, bringing it back to the Main World.

“The seventh traversal, the world I arrived in was too low-level, otherwise, I might have awakened another Divine Skill…” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

The seventh traversal was a backup traverse he had prepared specifically for facing the Heart Demon Tribulation.

“`

“`

“Currently, I possess three Physical Body Divine Abilities: Blood Rebirth, Mountain Moving, and Strengthening, among which Mountain Moving’s Divine Ability Imprint remains elusive.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The main reason is that he had spent too little time in the Main World, and there were many things to comprehend, leaving not much time for analyzing the Divine Ability of Mountain Moving.

…

“Next, it’s time for the Martial Path Evolutionary Path…” Lin Yuan’s spirit returned to his physical body, his expression slightly solemn.

After more than 920 years in the Spirit Realm, Lin Yuan had already completed the creation of the Eighth Stage of Martial Arts, and had even begun to contemplate the Fusion Rules.

“The Eighth Layer Part…” Lin Yuan’s spirit somewhat excited.

In the Main World, the Eighth Layer is a very important stage, and whether one can establish a stable Eighth Layer Evolution Path is regarded as an important symbol of becoming an Evolver Scholar.

“Let’s sort out the Eighth Layer Part first and then upload it to the Goddess of Wisdom.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, the main body of the Eighth Layer Part was essentially perfected by him, with only minor adjustments remaining.

It would not take much time.

Half a day later.

Lin Yuan directly connected to the Goddess of Wisdom.

“Respected Galaxy Master, the Goddess of Wisdom is pleased to serve you…”

A solemn and cool voice came through.

“I want to upload the Eighth Stage Martial Tao.” Lin Yuan stated directly.

Upon saying this.

The Goddess of Wisdom went briefly silent.

Then she immediately responded, “Galaxy Master, you may upload at any time.”

A moment later.

Lin Yuan uploaded the complete Eighth Layer Part to the Goddess of Wisdom.

For the Eighth Stage Martial Tao, Lin Yuan drew inspiration from the very essence of the Power of Creation in the Spirit Realm.

Martial Dao Cultivators stepping into the Eighth Layer were more likely to comprehend a certain Cosmic Force compared to Evolvers on other Evolution Paths.

Of course, ‘more likely’ here only meant that the difficulty was somewhat reduced. In fact, according to Lin Yuan’s vision, the vast majority of Martial Dao Cultivators at the Eighth Layer would not be able to comprehend the Cosmic Force.

Still, even so, Lin Yuan believed that the Eighth Stage Martial Tao was of great value because it involved the Cosmic Force.

How many of the Eighth Layer and even higher rank Evolution Paths recorded in Human Civilization have delved into the Cosmic Force?

In the descriptions of the Cosmic Force by Human Civilization and other Peak Clans, it was fundamentally regarded as impossible to replicate and entirely random.

The moment Lin Yuan finished uploading the Eighth Stage Martial Tao.

On a mysterious planet, incredibly distant from the Milky Way Main Star.

Screens flashed frantically, beginning to extrapolate the potential and details of the Eighth Stage Martial Tao.

“Detection of ‘Eighth Layer Part’ relating to numerous unknown Cosmic Forces, greatly enhancing the potential depth, reassessment of Martial Path Evolutionary Path underway…”

“Discovery of ‘Eighth Layer Part’ enhancing the fundamental explanation of rules, overall evaluation of Martial Path Evolutionary Path rising…”

“Discovering…”

….

“Triggering Human Civilization core contingency plans, contact with Goddess of Freedom, Goddess of Justice among others…”

“Triggering Human Civilization core contingency plans, contact with Xia Qin Supreme Being, Feather Butterfly Supreme Being…”

The three goddesses spared no computational power, repeatedly extrapolating the various extensions of the Eighth Stage Martial Tao…

…

“I wonder what the evaluation of the three goddesses will be for the Eighth Layer Part?”

On the Milky Way Main Star, Lin Yuan was somewhat expectant.

He had put a lot of effort into developing the Eighth Layer Part.

…

Outside the Milky Way Main Star.

In the depths of layer upon layer of space.

Five invincible Eighth Rank beings, led by the Dark Scale Race Sarath, were still waiting patiently.

They appeared to be shrewd hunters lurking in the darkness, waiting for their prey to emerge.
